name: prompt-mode-stats
description: `freecode -p "<prompt>" --stats` adds one stderr line of cost/timing info (model, ctx/output/total tokens, tool-call count, wall time) without touching the stdout contract. Reuses the prompt-mode fixture (one tool call, then a final answer) so toolCalls=1 is a fixed, assertable value. stdoutBlock pins the answer line followed immediately by end-of-output, so a stats line written to stdout after it (the order this code would produce on a regression) would break the block; stdoutContains proves the stats line reached stderr (stdout+stderr combined) with the right model id and field names.
prompt: what does the package say its name is
